classification.quality_note: Risk factor (FY2011 10-K): Our businesses are highly cyclical, in addition to experiencing some less significant seasonal effects.; no theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date. cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 5.18x; +66% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -2.52; conservative 2yr -1%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY11-FY11 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +6.5%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 1.3-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +6.5%/yr (no FY11-FY11 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +6.5%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY11-FY11: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2012-04-05) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 5.18x (30.9% downside to Bear $30 / +6.0% upside to Bull $46) | Adj composite 1.25 vs market 3.77: gap -2.52 [OVERVALUED] | +66% above the EPP floor $26 (7x FY12E $3.74) | Conservative 2-yr case: -1.2% total (-0.6%/yr) | At 11.6x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $57 sits above the BULL case; O&P–Americas -26.5% and Intermediates & Derivatives -31.6% operating income in Q4 2011, forward revenues +7.9% (no FY12 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2011 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date; none has dated evidence.
